title: Team customer access
description: Agents can find and link customers during a call only in customer groups their team has access to. Having a customer group grants no access by itself.

permissionHint.WORK: Agents in the team can find, link, and edit name/company of customers in this group during a call, and journeys owned by the team can enroll them. Doesn't include opening customers after the call ends.
permissionHint.VIEW: Shows customers in dphone screen-pop, lets admins and supervisors in the team open these customer profiles in Customer 360, and lets agents open customers of completed work. Doesn't allow finding or linking customers during a call.

empty: No team has access yet. Agents won't find customers during calls.
noTeams: No active teams yet. Create a team in organization settings first.
duplicate: This team already has this access to this customer group
granted: Access granted. Agents in the team will see customers within a few seconds.

revokeBody.WORK: Agents in this team will no longer find or link customers in this group during calls, and journeys owned by the team can't enroll them.
revokeBody.VIEW: Screen-pop will stop showing customers in this group, admins and supervisors in the team can't open their profiles, and agents can't open customers of completed work.

errors.teams: Couldn't load teams. The table shows team IDs instead of names.
errors.access: This account can't manage team access. Contact your organization's administrator.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

permissionAdvice: Agents who take calls and also open customers of completed work need both.
revokeKeeps: This team still has “{{permission}}” on this group. Revoking this doesn't affect it.
revokeAgain: You can grant it again later.
